histories.history: Renumbered and Amended by Chapter 172, 2025 General Session

section.catchline: Renter's credit authorized -- No interest allowed.
section.subsection: A claimant who rents a residence and meets the requirements of this part may receive a renter's credit.

A claimant who meets the requirements of this part and Part 3, Homeowner's Credit, may claim in any year a renter's credit under Section 59-2a-205, a homeowner's credit as provided under Part 3, Homeowner's Credit, or both.
Interest is not allowed on any payment made to a claimant under this part.
